archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-step3
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 prompt, shell wrapper, and normalizer now coordinate through bgjob result envs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the migrated /design Step 3 bgjob flow across the wrapper, prompt prose, and normalizer. Focus on whether fresh starts clear stale merge inputs, live registry rows rejoin instead of relaunching, and DONE routing requires BGJOB_RC=0 plus Step 3 KVs. Also check retained legacy fallback behavior does not let stale .step3-review-result.env override the bgjob result env. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
